infobox.usage: Unlocks the pier door on Terminal.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Pier door key (Pier) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: This key should fit the door that blocks access to the pier leading to the evacuation zone.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: In a safe inside the pumping station building (PS) on Terminal. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the pier on Terminal.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: The "Zubr Boat" extraction. Entering the door starts the 3 minute extraction timer.
